description: Grading in a segment: graders and seals since the last close (per Agent), queue and panel coverage at the last close, jury seats aligned and not aligned per close, and the calibration totals. Use it to see who is grading now and how juries aligned.

dir.description: desc (default: the key's natural order, highest first for numbers, A to Z for names, fewest closes left first for left, a level in its order) or asc (reversed); blanks last either way

limit.description: maximum graders in seals_since_close to return (1 to 1000, default 25)

segment.description: chain segment: omit for the current one; 1 reads segment 1 (archived at the 2026-10-24 genesis cut), whose epoch numbers repeat in the current segment

sort.description: seals_since_close order: seals (default), score or a Score part, or name (A to Z)

name: get_governance_graders
title: Governance graders
